review.notes: Full read-through of the OCR lines against extracted text from all 28 physical PDF pages, plus code-fence and heading-structure checks (no fence markers; structure clean). Large delete/replace runs against the text layer resolved to figure-internal labels of embedded figures (Figures 1-4, 6-8, 10) and the transposed HTML layout of Tables 1-4, whose bodies and captions are all present. Physical pages 1 and 4 were rendered to confirm the two dropped footnote lines restored by patches. The print's own wording was preserved: p.5 prints "Sign Distance Function" while p.4 prints "Signed Distance Function" (paper's own inconsistency, not an OCR defect).
